'''April 2001 Las Vegas tournament (7 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas on 7 April 2001. [[Shane Watner]] won it. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2035">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-08-vegas-sugar-rushd2035/ vegas-sugar-rush], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 8 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-08-vegas-sugar-rushd2035/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Shane Watner]]
